summary_ja: シナリオ法の承認を受けた最終指定親会社が届出を要する場合と、承認基準を満たさない場合の改善計画の提出を定める。
summary_en: Specifies when an Ultimate Designated Parent Company approved to use the scenario method must notify changes and requires an improvement plan if approval standards are no longer met.
paragraphs: An Ultimate Designated Parent Company that has obtained approval for the use of the scenario method shall, where any of the following items applies, notify the Commissioner of the Financial Services Agency of that fact and its details without delay: (i) where there is a change in the matters stated in the application for approval; (ii) where there is a material change in the matters stated in the documents attached to the application for approval; (iii) where grounds arise under which the approval standards of the preceding Article are not satisfied.

Where giving a notification under item (iii) of the preceding paragraph, the Ultimate Designated Parent Company shall submit a plan for improvement concerning the matters in respect of which it does not satisfy the approval standards, together with that notification or promptly thereafter.
